# Widget `match-pairs` — Match the pairs

**Pack:** core

**When to use:** Use for one-to-one associations: term ↔ definition, word ↔ translation, cause ↔ effect, symbol ↔ meaning.

## Example block

```json
{
  "kind": "widget",
  "type": "match-pairs",
  "title": "Match the pairs",
  "props": {
    "prompt": "Match each organelle with its job.",
    "pairs": [
      {
        "left": "Mitochondrion",
        "right": "Makes ATP"
      },
      {
        "left": "Ribosome",
        "right": "Builds proteins"
      },
      {
        "left": "Nucleus",
        "right": "Stores DNA"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## Props

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `prompt` | string | no |
| `pairs` | array of object (3–8) | yes |
| `pairs[].left` | string | yes |
| `pairs[].right` | string | yes |

The validator also checks the cross-field rules (ids that must exist, lengths that must match,
expressions that must parse). Run `npm run validate` after writing a widget.
